1: Metha, a struggling single father desperate to provide for his young daughter , Nawa , accepts a high-paying but suspicious night shift job at a remote suburban convenience store. Upon arrival, he discovers that he must survive a strict, bizarre, and terrifying set of supernatural workplace rules.

Tensions rise inside the store as the staff tries to manage their duties. The episode focuses heavily on curiosity becoming a death sentence; characters learn the hard way that digressing from your assigned task or poking around into things you shouldn't be looking at triggers paranormal retaliation.

A tense, high-stakes situation unfolds that blurs the lines between living and supernatural threats. Paranoia takes over the night shift as the crew faces internal betrayals, proving that the living people trapped in the store can be just as deadly and deceitful as the spirits lurking in the shadows.

The dark history between Metha and Nam begins to come to light. The episode reveals the origin of their pact, the truth behind their relationship, and the devastating investment scam that pushed Nam toward dark magic.
